units.source_text: 老朋友照我的意思办妥了这件事。

en.t: My old friend settled the matter according to my wishes.

units.source_text: 不过，那已经是我回到东京后，过了很久的事了。

en.t: However, that happened only long after I had returned to Tokyo.

units.source_text: 打算在乡下卖地，也不是那么容易卖掉的，

en.t: Trying to sell land in the countryside was not so easy,

units.source_text: 而且一旦给人家摸了底，便会被买主狠狠杀价，

en.t: and once people sensed my situation, buyers would force the price down mercilessly,

units.source_text: 所以我最终卖的价钱，比时价亏了许多。

en.t: so in the end I sold it for far less than its market value.

units.source_text: 坦白地说，我的财产只有离家时身上带的若干公债和后来这位朋友汇来的这笔钱。

en.t: To be frank, my only property consisted of the few government bonds I had taken with me when I left home and the money this friend later sent me.

units.source_text: 不用说，父母的遗产自然是少得可怜。

en.t: Needless to say, my parents' inheritance had become pitifully small.

units.source_text: 而且，这又不是我主动减少的，因此心情越发恶劣。

en.t: Moreover, I had not reduced it by any action of my own, which made me feel all the worse.

units.source_text: 但是，对于维持一个学生的生活来说，这些钱绰绰有余。

en.t: But for maintaining the life of a student, that money was more than enough.

units.source_text: 说实在的，我连这些钱的利息的一半都没用完。

en.t: To tell the truth, I did not even use half of the interest from it.

units.source_text: 正是这阔绰的学生生活，后来使我陷入了万万想不到的境况。

en.t: It was precisely this comfortable student life that later led me into circumstances I could never have imagined.
